name: Unified Desks
author: Billy Coover
description: Two monitors, one desktop. SUPER+1-5 moves BOTH screens together to a paired set of workspaces, and each bar shows its own screen. For exactly 2 monitors.

barWidget.description: Five paired desks across two monitors. SUPER+1-5 or a click moves both screens at once; each bar reflects the screen it is drawn on.
